in_greek.name: Shoshanna
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Gift of God
in_greek.long_meaning: Shoshanna είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Hebrew name Shoshana, meaning ‘rose’ or ‘grace’. In the Bible, Shoshanna (Shoshannah) is a variant of the name Hagar, the Egyptian concubine of Abraham. It symbolizes God's grace and favor towards Hagar and her son Ishmael.

in_latin.name: Shoshanna
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Gift of God
in_latin.long_meaning: Shoshanna est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Hebrew name Shoshana, meaning ‘rose’ or ‘grace’. In the Bible, Shoshanna (Shoshannah) is a variant of the name Hagar, the Egyptian concubine of Abraham. It symbolizes God's grace and favor towards Hagar and her son Ishmael.
